name: HuaMeng YS3M 3x3 Ball-Core (Magnetic Core + MagLev)
description: The MoYu HuaMeng YS3M is the latest flagship 3x3 release from the famous cube company. This puzzle features amazing corner cutting, adjustable tensions/compressions, a dragon scale pattern to reduce sticking, and is designed/endorsed by the 3x3 world record single holder YuSheng Du.
